positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Oversaw the technical direction and work planning for the JobSeeker Segmentation, Application Tracker, and Notification Center teams, championed the use of AI tools, mentored engineers, and aligning with stakeholders on product direction
- Utilized MongoDB and Kafka to develop an API that helped scale the Job Seeker Application Tracker product from <900k visits to >16M visits per month, dropped job seeker interview no-shows by 15.8%, and allowed the product to expand outside of the US
- Coordinated efforts to align on segment coverage metrics, created a comprehensive dashboard for Product, and built Spark pipelines in Airflow to aggregate jobseeker metadata such as impressions to deliver segments to better understand jobseekers.
- Mentored 6+ senior and junior engineers with weekly 1:1 sessions discussing career progression and technical guidance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for designing and delivering highly scalable and reliable systems for the JobSeeker Email Job Subscription (JobAlerts) and Notification Center teams
- Designed and led the implementation of Notification Center platform that managed jobseeker events and notifications using Kafka and RabbitMQ. Increased revenue by 0.6% and applies by 0.75%, 59% users returned after initial visit, and time to meaningfully interaction decreased by 2.8%
- Tech lead for high priority initiative from CTO to provide a daily status updates via email of all their applications on Indeed. Increased visits to Indeed by 0.8%. Open rate was 40%, helpfulness at 70%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented various features using A/B testing in the Application Tracker and JobSeeker Email Job Subscriptions (JobAlerts) products to increase engagement and sign ups
- Implemented full stack features using ReactJS and Spring

positions.title: National Security Engineering Division Intern
positions.description:
• Responsible for developing Software-Defined Radio framework for project
• Built C++ programs to measure the length of capture for Software-Defined Radio
• Developed modules to process Wi-Fi signals using GNU Radio API (C++)
• Created several bash scripts to expedite development process
• Setup Version Control for project

positions.title: Performance Excellence Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted in research for alternative strategies for Pillstation project
- Installed Pillstations in Kaiser patients' homes
- Assisted Nurses in recording and reporting of patients' vital signs to doctors
- Performed Quality Assurance on Pillstations

projects.title: P2P Messaging Client
projects.description:
A simple peer-to-peer instant messaging client that can discover users connected to the same local network, as well as communicate with external users. 
- Implemented in C++
- Uses TCP & UDP
- Has semi graphical user interface within terminal

projects.title: Rideshare Android Application
projects.description:
Rideshare is an android carpooling application developed with a team of 4. 
- Application developed in Java
- Server developed in Python
- The application was capable of handling user registration, carpool searching, and ride requests.
